statements.summary: Project background documents and meeting transcripts for Northfield College campus room booking.

citations.quote: # Campus Room Booking: Project Brief
Prepared by the Facilities Office, Northfield College.
## Background
# Kickoff meeting: Campus Room Booking
Attendees: Dana Ruiz (Facilities Manager, project sponsor), Sam Okafor (Student Union representative), Priya Nair (IT developer), Alex Kim (product owner).
**Alex (Product owner):** Thanks for coming.

statements.summary: Students and staff book 24 group-study rooms in the library via email and spreadsheets, causing double bookings.

citations.quote: Students and staff book the 24 group-study rooms in the library by emailing the Facilities Office. Requests are tracked in a shared spreadsheet, double bookings happen several times a week, and nobody can see which rooms are free without asking.

statements.summary: Goals are to let students and staff see free rooms and book them, reduce double bookings to zero, and give the Facilities Office a single view.

citations.quote:
- Let students and staff see which study rooms are free and book one themselves.
- Reduce double bookings to zero.
- Give the Facilities Office a single view of all bookings.

statements.summary: Students and staff sign in with their existing college account.

citations.quote: - Students and staff sign in with their existing college account.

statements.summary: A user can search rooms by date, time and capacity, and book an individual one-off slot.

citations.quote: - A user can search rooms by date, time and capacity, and book an individual one-off slot.

statements.summary: There is a conflict over maximum booking length between the brief stating up to 4 hours and Facilities wanting at most 3 hours.

citations.quote: - A booking can last up to 4 hours.
**Dana (Facilities):** One more thing on length. The brief says four hours, but three hours is the most I want for a single booking, or rooms get hogged.

statements.summary: The Facilities Office can block a room for maintenance.

citations.quote: - The Facilities Office can block a room for maintenance.

statements.summary: Cancellation policies and no-show rules are open until Dana confirms with Student Services.

citations.quote: We have not yet agreed what happens when someone cannot attend a booking. The Facilities Office will discuss this with Student Services.
**Dana (Facilities):** We need a rule for no-shows, and for how late someone can cancel, but I have to check with Student Services first.
**Alex (Product owner):** Okay, cancellation and no-shows stay open until Dana confirms.

statements.summary: The booking service will reject an overlapping booking for the same room.

citations.quote: **Priya (IT):** The booking service will reject an overlapping booking for the same room.

statements.summary: Recurring bookings are out of scope for release one.

citations.quote: **Dana (Facilities):** Not in the first release. Recurring bookings make the clash rules much harder, so let's leave recurring bookings out for now and revisit after launch.
**Alex (Product owner):** Agreed. Recurring reservations are out of scope for release one.

statements.summary: Syncing bookings to people's Outlook calendars is proposed as a nice feature.

citations.quote: **Priya (IT):** Maybe we could also sync bookings to people's Outlook calendars? It might be nice.
**Alex (Product owner):** Possibly, but let's not commit to that today.

statements.summary: The Facilities office needs to see who booked each room, but students should only see that a room is taken without knowing who took it.

citations.quote: **Dana (Facilities):** Also, my office needs to see who booked each room. Students should only see that a room is taken, not who took it.

items.title: Room Searching and Booking
items.description: Allow students and staff to find and book available study rooms without overlapping reservations.

items.title: Facilities Management
items.description: Give the Facilities Office comprehensive views, maintenance controls, and attendee visibility.

items.title: User Authentication
items.description: As a student or staff member, I want to sign in with my existing college account, so that I can access the booking system.

criteria.text: When a user logs in with valid college credentials, authentication succeeds and they can proceed.

items.title: Room Search and Slot Reservation
items.description: As a user, I want to search rooms by date, time and capacity, and book an individual one-off slot, so that I can secure a study space.

criteria.text: When a user searches by date, time, and capacity, matching rooms are displayed.

citations.quote: A user can search rooms by date, time and capacity, and book an individual one-off slot.

criteria.text: When a user books an available one-off slot, the reservation is confirmed.

items.title: Conflict Prevention
items.description: As a user, I want the booking service to reject overlapping bookings, so that double bookings are eliminated.

criteria.text: When a booking overlaps with an existing reservation for the same room, the booking service rejects it.

citations.quote: The booking service will reject an overlapping booking for the same room.

items.title: Room Availability Visibility for Students
items.description: As a student, I want to see which study rooms are free, so that I can find an open room.

criteria.text: When a student views the room schedule, occupied rooms show as taken without revealing who booked them.

citations.quote: Students should only see that a room is taken, not who took it.

items.title: Single View of Bookings for Facilities Office
items.description: As a member of the Facilities Office, I want a single view of all bookings, so that I can see who booked each room.

criteria.text: When a facilities user views the bookings list, all reservations display along with the identity of the person who booked each room.

citations.quote: my office needs to see who booked each room.

items.title: Block Room for Maintenance
items.description: As a member of the Facilities Office, I want to block a room for maintenance, so that users cannot book it during maintenance periods.

criteria.text: When the Facilities Office blocks a room for maintenance, the room becomes unavailable for booking during that period.

citations.quote: The Facilities Office can block a room for maintenance.

questions.subject: Maximum Booking Length
questions.question: What is the exact maximum allowed duration for a single booking: up to 4 hours or at most 3 hours?
questions.why_it_matters: The project brief and the Facilities Manager's statements conflict regarding the maximum booking duration.

citations.quote: A booking can last up to 4 hours.
The brief says four hours, but three hours is the most I want for a single booking

questions.subject: Cancellation and No-Show Policy
questions.question: What are the specific rules and penalties for no-shows and how late a user can cancel a booking?
questions.why_it_matters: These policies are currently open and pending confirmation with Student Services.

citations.quote: We have not yet agreed what happens when someone cannot attend a booking.
We need a rule for no-shows, and for how late someone can cancel
cancellation and no-shows stay open until Dana confirms.
